tool.name: setup_repo
tool.description:
Clone a git URL or register a local path/folder as the code audit target.
Accepts: - HTTP/HTTPS/SSH git URLs → cloned to strix_runs/<run_name>/repo/ - Absolute or relative local paths → used in-place (no copy)
Safe to call multiple times — skips clone if destination already exists.
Returns the absolute local repo_path and the workspace_subdir name (used to find the repo at /workspace/<workspace_subdir> inside Docker).
Call this FIRST before any scanning.

parameter.name: repo
parameter.description: Git URL (https://github.com/...) or absolute/relative local path to the repository or folder to audit.

parameter.name: run_name
parameter.description: The run identifier (e.g. strix-run-abc123). Used as the parent directory for cloned repos and proposals.

parameter.name: branch
parameter.description: Branch or tag to checkout (default: "main"). Ignored for local paths.

returns.description: On success: {success, repo_path (abs local path), branch, commit_sha, is_clone, workspace_subdir}. On failure: {success: false, error}.

tool.name: detect_language
tool.description:
Detect the primary programming language of a repository.
Checks root and one level deep for: - go.mod → Go (go_modules) - pom.xml → Java (maven) - build.gradle / build.gradle.kts → Java (gradle)
Returns detected language, build system, and evidence files found.

parameter.name: repo_path
parameter.description: Absolute local path to the repository returned by setup_repo.

parameter.name: hint
parameter.description: Force detection to "go" or "java" if already known. Default: "auto".

returns.description: {success, detected ("go"|"java"|"unknown"), build_system, evidence [list of filenames found]}.

tool.name: write_fix_proposal
tool.description:
Write a fix proposal (unified diff + optional test code) for human review.
NEVER applies the fix automatically — writes files only for human inspection and approval.
Proposal files are written to: strix_runs/<run_name>/proposals/<finding_id>/fix.diff strix_runs/<run_name>/proposals/<finding_id>/<test_file_path>
The unified_diff must be a valid unified diff (--- a/... +++ b/...).

parameter.name: run_name
parameter.description: The run identifier (same as used in setup_repo).

parameter.name: finding_id
parameter.description: The finding ID this fix addresses (e.g. CODE-0001). Used as the proposal subdirectory name.

parameter.name: file_path
parameter.description: Relative path of the source file being fixed (e.g. cmd/server/main.go). For documentation purposes.

parameter.name: unified_diff
parameter.description: Complete unified diff in --- a/file +++ b/file format. Must include context lines (3 minimum).

parameter.name: test_code
parameter.description: Optional test code that exercises or verifies the fix. Leave empty if no test is proposed.

parameter.name: test_file_path
parameter.description: Filename for the test file (e.g. main_test.go). Defaults to fix_test.go if test_code is provided.
